description: Find-the-code tasks on the MDDB repository for the agent benchmark (AGT-004). question is what the agent is asked; grep is the term an agent would search for first; answer is the file that holds the code to change. Run against a collection made with `mddb-cli autoindex` from the repository root.

tasks.question: where is the document revision token computed for conditional writes
how is a metadata index entry split into key, value and document id
how does a passage pick the line where the query terms meet
where are results cut to fit the context token budget
autoindex sets include paths for C headers in the collection config
in what order does the server shut its components down
where is the bbolt freelist persisted on close
default alpha weight of hybrid search fusion
how is nDCG computed for an evaluation query
generic helper that keeps the top k items per group
how does reference add detect the licence of a cloned repository
fall back to the flat vector index while another index is loading
cross-collection full-text search fused with reciprocal rank fusion
which MCP tools a request may see given its API key toolsets
parse the --fail-below thresholds of mddb-cli eval
